series_start_reason: Same as Eloctate: Sanofi consolidated Bioverativ from March 9, 2018, so its Q1 2018 Alprolix figure (EUR 21 million) is a part-quarter and is excluded; no Bioverativ Q1 2018 10-Q exists. 2014Q2-2017Q4 Biogen/Bioverativ history (USD) is in sanofi_alprolix_alt.
generic_name: eftrenonacog alfa (coagulation factor IX recombinant, Fc fusion protein)
moa: Recombinant factor IX Fc fusion protein (extended half-life factor IX replacement)

approval_evidence.quote: ALPROLIX brand Coagulation Factor IX (Recombinant), Fx Fusion Protein (rFIX-Fc) was approved in the United States on 28 March 2014 and was commercially available starting on 05 May 2014.

notes: launch_quarter 2014Q2: FDA Summary Basis for Regulatory Action states US approval 28 March 2014 and commercial availability from 05 May 2014; Biogen's Q2 2014 release prints the first ALPROLIX revenue (USD 10,397 thousand). For Q1/Q2 2026 Sanofi's summary table prints Alprolix with the quarter then H1 columns as for earlier years.
